title: Manager | SAP SD | Delhi | SAP | DSA Metals, Mining and Industrial
description:
**Manager | SAP SD | Delhi | SAP | DSA Metals, Mining and Industrial**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 112378
  
• **Location**: Delhi
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team**

Enterprise technology must do much more than keep the wheels turning; it is the engine that drives functional excellence and the enabler of innovation and long-term growth. Learn more about ET&P

**Your work profile**

* Lead SAP SD workstreams across implementation, rollout, transformation, enhancement, upgrade, and support engagements, ensuring successful delivery of business objectives.
* Drive end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) process design and optimization, aligning SAP SD solutions with organizational goals and industry best practices.
* Gather business requirements, conduct workshops, and translate complex business needs into scalable SAP SD solutions.
* Configure and support key SAP SD functionalities including Sales Order Processing, Pricing, Billing, Shipping, Transportation Execution, Credit Management, Returns Processing, Rebates, and Output Management.
* Design and oversee integration between SAP SD and MM, FI, PP, WM/EWM, CRM, and other enterprise applications.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders for process improvement, digital transformation, and SAP S/4HANA adoption initiatives.
* Lead Fit-Gap analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, cutover planning, go-live activities, and post-production stabilization.
* Review and approve functional specifications for reports, interfaces, enhancements, forms, workflows, and integration developments.
* Manage SIT, UAT, defect resolution, deployment activities, and business readiness planning.
* Oversee application support, incident management, change requests, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Lead cross-functional teams, mentor consultants, and drive adherence to SAP best practices, governance standards, and delivery methodologies.
* Manage project plans, resource allocation, budgets, risks, escalations, and stakeholder communications across multiple engagements.
* Support pre-sales activities, solutioning, effort estimations, proposal development, and client presentations.

**Key Requirements**

* 10-15+ years of SAP experience with strong expertise in SAP Sales and Distribution (SD).
* Proven experience leading end-to-end SAP implementation, transformation, rollout, and support projects.
* Strong expertise in Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes including Sales Orders, Pricing, Billing, Shipping, Transportation, Credit Management, Returns, Rebates, and Output Determination.
* Extensive hands-on experience in SAP SD configuration, process design, and solution architecture.
* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA SD capabilities and transformation initiatives.
* Deep integration knowledge across SAP MM, FI, PP, WM/EWM, CRM, and other related SAP modules.
* Experience working with IDocs, EDI integrations, interfaces, and third-party applications.
* Strong understanding of logistics execution, supply chain processes, and customer order management.
* Experience leading project delivery, resource management, stakeholder engagement, governance, and risk management activities.
* Exposure to SAP Fiori, modern SAP user experience solutions, and digital transformation programs is preferred.
* Experience supporting global rollouts, multi-country implementations, and enterprise-scale SAP programs.
* Strong leadership, people management, mentoring, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, teams, and priorities within a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with SAP Activate, Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery methodologies is highly desirable.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
* SAP SD or SAP S/4HANA Sales certification is preferred.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent project management certification will be an added advantage.
* Additional certifications in SAP S/4HANA, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or Digital Transformation domains are desirable.
* Experience in global SAP transformation programs, enterprise process optimization, and customer-centric business environments is highly valued.

title: Presales Executive
description:
**Position:** Pre\-Sales Executive

**Department:** Business Development

**Location:** Ghitorni, New Delhi

**Reporting To:** Business Development Manager / Sales Head

**Job Summary**

The Pre\-Sales Executive will be responsible for managing customer enquiries, qualifying leads, preparing preliminary BOQs and estimates, and supporting the sales team throughout the pre\-sales process. The role requires excellent communication skills, strong customer interaction abilities, and proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle customer enquiries through calls, WhatsApp, email, website, and other communication channels.
* Understand customer requirements and provide initial product and service information.
* Qualify leads and schedule meetings for the Sales/Design team.
* Prepare preliminary BOQs, cost estimates, and quotations.
* Prepare client presentations and proposals using Microsoft PowerPoint.
* Maintain enquiry trackers, customer database, and sales MIS.
* Coordinate with Design, Production, and Sales teams to gather project information and pricing.
* Ensure timely follow\-ups with prospective customers to support business conversion.
* Maintain accurate documentation of enquiries and customer interactions.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 1\-3 years of experience in Pre\-Sales, Sales Coordination, Customer Support, Customer Service, or Estimation.
* Experience in the Interior Design, Furniture, Architecture, or Construction industry will be an added advantage.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong command of the English language.
* Excellent customer handling and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (BOQs, formulas, calculations, reports, and data management).
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint for creating client presentations.
* Good analytical, numerical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong organizational and time management abilities.
* Ability to multitask and work in a fast\-paced environment.

Pay: ₹25,078\.67 \- ₹40,524\.53 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you Fluent In English
* Are you comfortable for 6 days workings
* Are you comfortable if your day\-off is in week days (Mon, Tues, or Wed)

Work Location: In person

title: Presales Consultant- Networking
description:
**Job Purpose:**  

Working with the companys Sales Team, the Presales Consultant is responsible for providing presales technical support to the Sales team and presenting tailored demonstrations or qualification discussions to customers and or prospects. The Presales Consultant also assists the Sales Team with qualifying opportunities – in or out and helping expand existing opportunities through solid questioning. The Presales Consultant will be responsible on conducting Technical Proof of Concept, Demonstration and Presentation on the supported products and solution.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

* Assist Account and Product Managers with qualification of opportunities by providing presales technical support. e.g. assist and support complicated brands and or take self\-ownership on simple brands.
* Provides pre\-sales technical support and deliver product demonstrations to customers and business partners.
* Assist senior to deliver training to partners on products solution.
* Contribute to and refine technical RFP and RFI responses.
* Support customer demonstrations and presentations
* Coordinating and managing technical validation events (POC)
* Coordinating and managing POC assets
* Solely or partnering with other Pre\-sales consultant to support PM setting regular BOM (Bill of Materials)
* Participating in conferences, shows, exhibitions when appropriate and requested.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.


**Knowledge, Skills and Experience:**  

* 1 to 3 Years of relevant work experience is required.
* Required Education: Associate Degree in IT related programs
* Able to execute instructions and to request clarification when needed.
* Able to perform basic mathematical calculations.
* Able to communicate clearly and convey necessary information.
* Able to adjust readily to change and adapt as needed.
* Able to quickly learn/adapt to new systems and technology.

* Professional, office environment.

title: Travel Consultant
description:
About Paradise Yatra

Paradise Yatra is a growing travel company specializing in **Domestic \& International Holiday Packages, Honeymoon Packages, Group Tours, Luxury Holidays and customized travel experiences**.

We are looking for enthusiastic and target\-oriented **Travel Consultants** to join our sales team and help customers plan and book their dream holidays.

Key Responsibilities

* **Handle Travel Enquiries \& Leads**
* Respond to incoming leads through calls, WhatsApp and other channels.
* Understand customer requirements, budget, travel dates and preferences.
* **Prepare \& Sell Tour Packages**
* Create customized itineraries and travel packages according to customer requirements.
* Explain hotels, sightseeing, transfers, activities, inclusions and exclusions clearly.
* **Follow\-Up \& Conversion**
* Regularly follow up with potential customers through calls and WhatsApp.
* Convert qualified leads into confirmed bookings.
* **Customer Relationship Management**
* Maintain professional communication with customers throughout the sales process.
* Build trust and provide excellent pre\-sales and post\-sales support.
* **Achieve Sales Targets**
* Work towards monthly sales and booking targets.
* Maintain proper lead updates and follow\-up records in the company's CRM/system.

Skills Required

* Excellent communication and convincing skills.
* Good knowledge of travel destinations and tourism products.
* Strong sales and negotiation skills.
* Ability to understand customer requirements.
* Good WhatsApp, phone and computer handling skills.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.
* Target\-oriented and self\-motivated.

Who Can Apply?

* **Freshers are welcome.**
* Candidates with experience in travel sales, holiday packages, hospitality, hotel sales or BPO sales will be preferred.
* Candidates who enjoy travelling and interacting with people are encouraged to apply.

What We Offer

* Salary: **₹14,000 – ₹20,000/month**
* **Unlimited performance\-based incentives**
* Training on travel products and sales
* Career growth opportunities
* Opportunity to work with Domestic \& International holiday products
* Supportive and growth\-oriented work environment

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

**Communicative \+ Sales\-Oriented \+ Customer\-Focused \+ Target\-Driven \+ Willing to Learn**

Apply Now

**Send your CV on WhatsApp:**  
**8791852095**

**Join Paradise Yatra and build your career in the Travel \& Tourism industry.**

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
